items.p:
NEW: number + noun. 3–10 take a PLURAL noun after them.
"three books"
items.why: 3–10 + plural noun in the genitive: ثلاثة كتبٍ (number first, then plural).

items.p:
NEW: "reverse gender". A MASCULINE noun takes a number WITH ة.
كِتَاب is masculine → "five books" = ?
items.why: Masculine singular (كتاب) → number with ة: خمسةُ كتبٍ. Strange but systematic!

items.p:
A FEMININE noun takes a number WITHOUT ة.
رِسَالَة is feminine → "three letters" = ?
items.why: Feminine singular (رسالة) → number WITHOUT ة: ثلاثُ رسائلَ.
ثمانية: ث (3 dots), ن (1 dot ABOVE), ي (2 below), ة.
ق-ر-أ: ر (no dot, curves below the line), hamza on alif.

items.p: Type in Arabic: "The boys read the book." (SUBJECT first)
Type in Arabic: "We didn't go to the city." (use لم)
Type in Arabic: "The pens are with them." (with them = معهم)
